changelog: Initial release: Two-stage FCFF DCF model with dynamic WACC calculation, three-scenario valuation (conservative/base/optimistic), sensitivity analysis matrix, and comprehensive risk disclosure. Supports all A-share listed companies with automated financial data fetching via Tushare API.
summary: DCF valuation modeling for A-share listed companies. Pass stock code to automatically fetch financial data, calculate WACC, run conservative/base/optimistic...
